# Ali Mohsen Maruf

> Personal portfolio of Ali Mohsen Maruf, a Geography and Environment undergraduate at Jahangirnagar University in Bangladesh. His interests include GIS, spatial research, land use and land cover assessment, and education technology.

## About

Ali explores how geographic information and digital products can make research and opportunities easier to understand and use. He is currently building AmarApply, a scholarship information and discovery platform.

## Selected work

- [AmarApply](https://scholarships.amarapply.com): Scholarship information and discovery platform.
- [Jahangirnagar University land cover assessment](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/alimohsenmaruf_gis-qgis-spatialanalysis-activity-7510648950807314432-EwSI): Preliminary QGIS and OpenStreetMap based spatial assessment.
